title.narrative: TRANSFORMING AGRI-FOOD SYSTEMS IN NIASSA PROVIN CE OF MOZAMBIQUE:PARTICIPATORY

description.narrative: The main objective of CIMMYT in Niassa Province is to improve resilience and create opportunities for diversified livelihood strategies for the communities in Niassa Province. To respond to this main goal, specific objectives were set out as follows: 1) to improve farm-level productivity by at least 30% using technological, socio-economic, and institutional innovations to increase household food security and incomes; 2) to improve market and enterprise performance by at least 30% and leverage digital and institutional innovations that will benefit women and youth and increase local processing and exports, 3) to enhance prevalence of gender and social inclusion programming for business development and leadership by women and youth to bring about organisational change in the target communities, 4) to improve household nutrition, dietary diversity and reduce food insecurity by at least 20% through nutrition education and new product development, and finally 5) to catalyse Stakeholder engagement by at least 20% in the selected value chains and enhance synergies with the private sector.CIMMYT will focus on the improvement of household food security and incomes for farmers through introduction of new technologies and promote access to financial resources. The project will be implemented through a Hub Model that takes into consideration learning and technology dissemination with the engagement of other service providers. N’gauma Agricultural School will be the central demonstration point for all technologies, from crop production to technologies on postharvest handling and household processing. The project will be implemented in 12 months, from the December 2024 to November 2025 period, covering 3,600 families in the districts of Lichinga, Chimbunila, Ngaúma, Mandimba, Mecanhelas and Cuamba.
